title: Mica On the Road

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: Hmmm. Interesting seeing you here. Not surprising. Interesting though.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hmmm. Interesting seeing you here. Not surprising. Interesting though.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: What's got you wandering around this part of Nivalis? Serial killer got you spooked? Or are you just trying to find that perfect ingredient for one of your second-rate recipes?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's got you wandering around this part of Nivalis? Serial killer got you spooked? Or are you just trying to find that perfect ingredient for one of your second-rate recipes?

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: Very witty. Now, I'm tasked with hunting you down and leaving you where you lie.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Very witty. Now, I'm tasked with hunting you down and leaving you where you lie.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: That's so nice of you. Those friends wouldn't be debt orphans would they?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's so nice of you. Those friends wouldn't be debt orphans would they?

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: Mhmm. I'm sure. Unless you were the one straddled with Gen Debt. I wonder what story your records hold.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mhmm. I'm sure. Unless you were the one straddled with Gen Debt. I wonder what story your records hold.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: I'd strongly consider keeping better friends.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'd strongly consider keeping better friends.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: You think Edison's hands are cleaner than mine?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You think Edison's hands are cleaner than mine?

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: No thank you. Those friends you're meeting ...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No thank you. Those friends you're meeting ...

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: I'd love to, really, but I've got a schedule to stick to. People that count on me. Kinda like these friends seem to have been counting on you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'd love to, really, but I've got a schedule to stick to. People that count on me. Kinda like these friends seem to have been counting on you.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: One week to make your choice. Oh, and either way? Make sure you kindly go fuck yourself.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: One week to make your choice. Oh, and either way? Make sure you kindly go fuck yourself.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: One week.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: One week.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: Listen, I know you think I'm the problem, but I'm not. A Network that can scrub your records - that's POWER. And power crushes little people like you. They're the problem. They don't care about you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Listen, I know you think I'm the problem, but I'm not. A Network that can scrub your records - that's POWER. And power crushes little people like you. They're the problem. They don't care about you.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: When the time comes that you're no longer useful, they'll drop you. Then you'll come begging me for help. Be smart. Help me NOW.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: When the time comes that you're no longer useful, they'll drop you. Then you'll come begging me for help. Be smart. Help me NOW.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: They wouldn't happen to have appointments with the Orphanage would they?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They wouldn't happen to have appointments with the Orphanage would they?

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: Those Gen Debtor kids don't get freedom. They'll become pawns of the Network. Recruits to a lost cause. And more importantly, important people lose money. Is that enough for you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Those Gen Debtor kids don't get freedom. They'll become pawns of the Network. Recruits to a lost cause. And more importantly, important people lose money. Is that enough for you?

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: You should know something about me. I'm not Teleshko. When I take aim at someone, I don't miss. Go away and think about that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You should know something about me. I'm not Teleshko. When I take aim at someone, I don't miss. Go away and think about that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Shit...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Shit...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Shit...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Shit...

pronounText.TextSheVersion: Mica... I was actually just leaving.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Mica... I was actually just leaving.
